name: Bao Dai Palace III
summary: Tour the rooms and garden of Bao Dai's summer villa, about 2.5 km south of the centre, for a look at the hill station the last emperor knew. Allow about an hour.
getThere: Taxi to 1 Trieu Viet Vuong, about 2.5 km south
heroCaption: The villa front at Bao Dai Palace III

notice.title: One ticket is this villa only
notice.body: The gate at 1 Trieu Viet Vuong is Palace III. The ticket does not cover the other Bao Dai houses.

body: Palace III is the hill villa at 1 Trieu Viet Vuong, about 2.5 km south of the centre. The rooms and the garden are the visit, and about an hour covers both.
Confirm the price at the gate before you pay. The ticket is for this villa only.

figures.caption: The garden at Bao Dai Palace III
figures.alt: Garden in front of Bao Dai Palace III in Da Lat

gettingThere: Take a taxi from Xuan Huong Lake to 1 Trieu Viet Vuong, about 2.5 km south of the centre.

legs.heading: From Xuan Huong Lake
legs.body: Taxi, about 2.5 km south to 1 Trieu Viet Vuong.

admissionNote: 25,000 VND (Visit Lâm Đồng); 60,000 VND (tour desks). Confirm at the gate. The visit is about 60 minutes.
